title: Field lines of a bar magnet
back: Closed loops: N → S outside, S → N inside. No monopoles, so net flux through any closed surface is zero.

title: Samples in a uniform field
back: Dia pushes lines out; para draws them in slightly; ferro concentrates them strongly.

title: Gauss’s law for magnetism
back: As many field lines leave a closed surface as enter it.

title: Field of a short bar magnet
back: Same form as the electric dipole with μ₀/4π in place of 1/4πε₀.

title: Magnet in a uniform field
legend: θ = angle between m and B
back: Stable along B; unstable opposite to B.

title: Susceptibility and permeability
back: Dia: χ < 0. Para: small χ > 0. Ferro: χ ≫ 1.

title: Curie’s law
back: Heating randomises the atomic moments, so χ falls.

title: Dia vs para vs ferro
back: Dia: χ small −ve, repelled (Bi, Cu). Para: χ small +ve, weakly attracted (Al, O₂). Ferro: χ huge, strongly attracted (Fe, Co, Ni).

title: Dia, para, ferro in one line
back: "Dia dur bhaage, Para paas aaye, Ferro fida ho jaaye": repelled, weakly attracted, strongly attracted.
